info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Finance Financial Compliance By Financial Compliance Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access detailed information about specific financial compliance records using their unique identifiers. It is designed for banking and finance professionals requiring insights into compliance status and related data. By utilizing the financial compliance ID, users can efficiently retrieve relevant compliance documentation and ensure adherence to regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include compliance officers, risk management teams, and auditors who rely on up-to-date compliance information for their operations.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about the financial compliance record identified by RES-100045. This includes all relevant attributes and compliance data associated with the specified resource.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve financial compliance information for the specified resource. Ensure that the required parameters are provided in the JSON format to get a successful response.

200.description: The request was successful and the requested data has been retrieved.
